AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-126
STEP 20. Replace the transfer drive gear or driven gear.
(1) Replace the transfer drive gear driven gear. Refer to 
GROUP 23B, Transaxle, Output Shaft P.23B-11.
(2) Start the engine and run.
(3) Read in the A/T diagnostic trouble code.
Q: Is the A/T diagnostic trouble code number "23" output?
YES : The A/T diagnostic trouble code may have set due to 
external radio frequency (RFI), possibility caused by 
cellular phone activity, after market components 
installed on the vehicle, etc.
NO : The inspection is complete.
